attr.title: Paperboat
attr.desc: Paper Mario 64 brought to you by HarbourMasters!
attr.inst: You need to provide your own roms. See the [Paperboat](https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Paperboat) repository for a list of supported rom hashes. At first boot you will be prompted to select your Paper Mario rom file via file picker. Once chosen, Torch will generate a `pm64.o2r`.
